facts.summary: Phase 3 topline missed all endpoints; other Phase 3 and extension studies discontinued · Phase 3 · simufilam in mild-to-moderate Alzheimer's disease · not yet approved

evidence.summary: topline results from the Phase 3 ReThink-ALZ study of simufilam in mild-to-moderate Alzheimer’s disease did not meet each of the pre-specified co-primary, secondary and exploratory biomarker endpoints.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: did not meet each of the pre-specified co-primary, secondary and exploratory biomarker endpoints
evidence.program_discontinued: the Company’s decision to discontinue its Phase 3 ReFocus-ALZ study and its open label extension study.
